verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents Smart Selection, which recognizes URLs and file paths under the cursor. The GitHub README adds that quad-click selects them, right-click offers context actions, and Cmd-click opens them. A community user confirms that Semantic History's Cmd+Click opens paths in an editor. Other users note it can create invalid file references and misses some path formats, such as Python tracebacks and git diff a/b prefixes. Missing for 10: documented keyboard-driven opening of a selected URL or path (copy mode only covers selecting text, not opening links), and reliable path recognition across common output formats.
